The '''Bank of the Core''' was a major banking company in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and one of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]'s largest financial institutions. The Bank of the Core was also a signatory sponsor of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].

==History==
One of the original signatory sponsors of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]], the Bank of the Core was one of the galaxy's largest financial institutions. At the height of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], the Bank of the Core owned at least a majority interest in over 3,000 different banking corporations in and out of the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. They also minted most of the [[Authority Cash Voucher|Authority's currency]], and controlled over three-quarters of the loans issued in the Sector.

The prominent [[House Praji/Legends|House Praji]] held a majority of its stock. The '''Core Bank''' headquarters itself was located in the [[Bank of the Core Plaza]], situated in the [[Financial District (Coruscant)/Legends|Financial District]] of the galactic capital, [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
